series.how_extracted: digitized from TM Fig. 6.10 (vector PDF rendered at 4x). x-axis is normalized forced stretch a=(3/2)(U/r)(r/r_o)^0.5, r_o=0.318 cm, NOT flow. flow_cm_s = a*r_o/1.5 = equivalent forced flow for the 0.318 cm rod (same U<->a mapping the authors use in TM Fig. 6.22, U/U_D, U_D=2 cm/s). For the larger rods the true U is higher by sqrt(r/r_o) (x1.22 or x1.41) but rod size is not identifiable per point in this figure. Uncertainty: O2 +-0.05 vol% (digitizing; sensor resolution 0.1%), a +-5% digitizing, but authors' flow error bars at a<5 s^-1 span roughly x0.5-x2 (U<1 cm/s poorly resolved). O2 is FINAL (post-burn) chamber O2.

notes: 1) PMMA uG data are vs normalized STRETCH RATE; flow_cm_s is the equivalent for the 0.318 cm rod (U=a*r_o/1.5). Per-test U is in TM Table A.5 but only as fan-pot/air-display ramps, not clean extinction flows, so it was not used. 2) O2 for BASS-II is final chamber O2 (O2 drops 0.5-1.3% during a burn). 3) No NASA-STD-6001 Test 1 MOC was found for PMMA or SIBAL; the 6001 MOC table in LPSC 2026 (Tapia Harper et al. ICES 2017) covers Solimide, Ultem, Nomex, NX2245 at 10.2 psia only (MOC 22-25%). Hirsch 15.4% is the closest 1g upward PMMA limit. 4) PMMA LOI (ASTM D2863) ~17 vol% appears only in vendor tables found (Zeus: 17); 17.3-17.7 not verified from a primary source this session, so it is omitted from one_g_limits. 5) No 1g limit for SIBAL was found. 6) ICES 2019 Olson 'Flammability Limits from BASS-II Testing in Microgravity Compared to Normal Gravity Limits' (ttu-ir.tdl.org) blocked (403); FSJ 2024 partial-g paper and Olson 1991 CST Kimwipe map not read. 7) uG minimum (13.5%) vs 1g upward (15.0-15.4%): PMMA burns ~1.5-2 vol% O2 lower in low-speed uG flow; partial-g centrifuge minimum ~13.7-13.8% near lunar g. 8) Pressure for all ISS/1g lab tests ~1 atm (ISS cabin ~101 kPa); exact values not tabulated.
